// Function describes one function for people.
type Function struct {
	Group string
	Usage string // "NAME(arguments)"
	Help  string
	// Example evaluates to Result when A1:A4 hold 4, 8, 15, 16 and B1:B4 hold
	// ale, mead, ale, rum. Functions that read the chain have no example.
	Example, Result string
}

// Functions lists every function a formula can call.

	return []Function{
		{"Totals", "SUM(values...)", "Adds numbers. Text and blanks in a range are skipped.", "=SUM(A1:A4)", "43"},
		{"Totals", "PRODUCT(values...)", "Multiplies numbers.", "=PRODUCT(A1:A2)", "32"},

files.name: BUILD-NOTES.md
files.body:
# BUILD-NOTES.md — Tavern Board (rewritten 25 Nov 2026, Gno v1.8)

## What was built

On-chain forum/board for Gno.land (Onyx testnet): posts and replies are chain
state, authors earn GNOT tips, front page ranks posts by tips received.

- `realm.gno` — realm implementation on the **Gno v1.8 API** (see "Rewrite" below)
- `realm_test.gno` — 8 unit tests (posts, replies, render, validation)
- `filetests/z_tip_filetest.gno` — filetest (tip flows, leaderboard, refund)
- `gnomod.toml` — module `gno.land/r/tavernboard`
- `../gnowork.toml` — workspace root (lets `gno test` resolve the realm locally)
- `README.md`, `LICENSE` (MIT), this file

## Verified by the coordinator (not taken on trust)

### `gno test` — 9/9 PASS (Gno v1.8.0, 25 Nov ~17:45 WIB)

```
ok . 2.01s
TestCreatePost, TestCreatePostValidation, TestCreateReply,
TestCreateReplyValidation, TestRenderBoard, TestRenderPost,
TestRenderErrors, TestRenderEscapesUserContent — PASS
./z_tip_filetest.gno — PASS (gas 6,279,791)
```

The filetest proves the money movement with distinct author/tipper addresses:
author balance +1000 on a 1000ugnot tip, reply author +500, leaderboard order
500 > 300 > 100, author-tips totals, and a 500ugnot leftover refund
(send 1500, tip 1000).

### gnodev local verification — all live (25 Nov ~18:00 WIB)

gnodev loaded the realm cleanly (no dependency errors), gnoweb on :8888.
Real transactions against the local node (`http://localhost:26657`):

| Call | Height | Tx hash | Gas used |
|---|---|---|---|
| CreatePost "Hello from gnodev" | 3 | `PpbJI8kk/tHbuFZZOoSRFLaIuRMYFiZ1PwYfbmtSkWA=` | 2,970,356 |
| CreateReply (post 1) | 5 | `KOVa+OFLFYaocSTaBjdYXxncdPYWgZIeOOo26NLpYYk=` | 2,900,196 |
| TipPost 1, 1000ugnot (`-send 1000ugnot`) | 7 | `S/iFwaJRrenbPbRsqksa7kiIYMTDfAN3ZzuJ+yxFw6s=` | 3,704,065 |

State verified via `gnokey query vm/qeval`:
`GetPost(1)` → TipTotal **1000**, ReplyCount **1**; `GetAuthorTips` → **1000**;
`GetPosts()` returns the post in the leaderboard.

Render verified via curl:
- `/r/tavernboard` (200) shows "Hello from gnodev", "Tips: 1000 ugnot", "Replies: 1"
- `/r/tavernboard:post/1` (200) shows the post, the reply, "Back to Board"
- `/r/tavernboard:post/abc` renders "Invalid post ID"

Gas note: a call needs `-gas-wanted 5000000` (first attempt at 2000000 failed
"out of gas" in simulation; suggested gas-wanted was 3,118,885).

## The rewrite (why the first version was wrong)

The builder's first version used the old v0.9-era API (`gno.land/p/std`,
`gno.land/r/system/bank`, `std.GetCaller`, `bank.Send`, `Render()` with no
argument). That API does not exist in Gno v1.8: no example in the repo imports
`gno.land/p/std`, and `gno test` could not resolve those packages at all.
The realm was rewritten to the sanctioned v1.8 API, following the official
examples (`examples/gno.land/r/demo/disperse`, `examples/gno.land/r/gnoland/boards2`)
and `~/.gno/src/AGENTS.md`:

- `address` / `realm` are built-in types (no import); caller via
  `cur.Previous().Address()`; `chain` + `chain/banker` for money
  (`banker.GetCoin`, `banker.NewBanker(BankerTypeRealmSend, cur)`,
  `SendCoins`); imports `"strconv"`, `"strings"`, `"errors"`, `"time"`.
- `Render(path string)` — gnoweb requires the path argument (`""` = front
  page, `"post/<id>"` = detail). Links use the colon-args form
  (`/r/tavernboard:post/1`). User content is markdown-escaped.
- Tips follow the **disperse pattern**: a RealmSend banker moves coins out of
  the realm's balance, guarded by `cur.Previous().IsUserCall()` (required
  with `unsafe.OriginSend()` — a non-EOA caller could otherwise spend
  pre-existing realm balance) plus a balance check that the realm actually
  holds the sent coins. An OriginSend banker would be safer by construction
  but cannot be exercised in a filetest (the envelope belongs to the
  filetest package), so RealmSend + guard is the sanctioned, testable shape.

## Test-framework lessons (all learned the hard way, 25 Nov)

- In `_test.gno`, `cross(cur)` always passes the test frame's own realm
  (a code realm, `IsUserCall() == false`); `SetRealm`/`SetOriginCaller`
  do NOT change it. Tip flows therefore live in a **filetest**, not unit tests.
- `cross()` only accepts the frame's current `cur` or a bare realm identifier;
  `cross(expr)` and passing a plain realm value are rejected at preprocess.
- `testing.SetRealm` mutates the **current frame's** captured cur — it must be
  called directly in `main`, not via a helper (a helper's SetRealm dies with
  the helper's frame).
- A filetest that imports its own realm needs a `gnowork.toml` workspace root
  above the package, or the loader tries to download the realm from chain.
- Never call `err.Error()` on a possibly-nil error when building a check
  message — it panics ("method selector on nil interface").

## Environment quirk (sandbox only, not a code issue)

This VM's egress proxy breaks Go tools' direct dials: `gnokey`/`gno` use a
custom dialer that ignores `https_proxy`, so direct RPC calls fail with a TLS
error. A local TLS reverse proxy (`/tmp/gnomitm`, 127.0.0.1:8443 → Onyx RPC,
8444 → mainnet RPC) works around it for `gnokey` queries; `gno test`'s
filetest download path does not use it (hence the `gnowork.toml` fix above).
None of this affects the realm or a normal developer machine.

## Honest gaps — NOT verified yet

- **NOT deployed to Onyx.** The deploy key
  (`g15kxyhlw2zgz2l2sg8526j0nw5j77mkumyuztwj`) holds **0 GNOT**. The Onyx
  faucet (`https://faucet.onyx.testnets.gno.land`) is a JS SPA with Google
  reCAPTCHA + hCaptcha + GitHub OAuth — it needs a **browser task** to claim
  test GNOT. No deployment, no Onyx tip tx, no explorer link until then.
- **README's deploy `-gas-wanted 10000000` is an estimate**, not measured:
  the addpkg gas will only be known from the deployment simulation.
- The gnodev tip above was self-directed (one funded account was both author
  and tipper). Cross-address transfer is proven by the filetest; a
  cross-address tip on Onyx is still to be done after deployment (fund a
  second key from the deploy key, have it author a post, tip it from the
  deploy key).

## Keys (test-only, never in the repo)

- Deploy key `tavern-board-testnet` → `g15kxyhlw2zgz2l2sg8526j0nw5j77mkumyuztwj`
  in the gnokey keybase (`~/.config/gno`, passphrase-encrypted). The brief
  asked for `~/workspace/gnome-tavern/keys/tavern-board.key`; the builder put
  it in the keybase instead. Key material was never printed or stored in the repo.
- Throwaway local test keys (unfunded, test-only): `tb_author1..5`, `tb_tipper1`,
  `gnodev-default` (gnodev's deterministic test account, recovered from the
  mnemonic gnodev prints). All passphrase-protected with a throwaway password.

## Time spent (coordinator rewrite + verification, 25 Nov)

- Root-cause + v1.8 API study: ~40 min
- Realm + test rewrite, filetest, workspace fix: ~60 min
- `gno test` 9/9 + gnodev live verification (3 txs, qeval, render): ~30 min
- Docs (README + this file): ~15 min

files.name: README.md
files.body:
# Tavern Board

An on-chain forum/board for Gno.land where posts and replies are chain state and authors earn GNOT tips.

## Features

- **Posts & Replies**: Create posts with title and body, reply to posts
- **GNOT Tips**: Tip posts and replies with ugnot (micro-GNOT) — tips land straight in the author's balance, with any leftover send refunded to the tipper
- **Per-Author Balances**: Track total tips received by each author
- **Tip Leaderboard**: Front page ranks posts by total tips received
- **Pure Gno**: Deterministic, no goroutines, no os, no networking; Gno stdlib imports only (`chain`, `chain/banker`, `chain/runtime/unsafe`, `errors`, `strconv`, `strings`, `time`)

## Quick Start (Local Development)

### Prerequisites

- Go 1.27.4+
- Gno toolchain v1.8.0 (`gno`, `gnokey`, `gnodev`, `gnoweb`) — see https://github.com/gnolang/gno

```bash
export PATH="$HOME/.gno/bin:$PATH"
export GNOROOT="$HOME/.gno/src"
```

### Run Tests

From the workspace root (the `gnowork.toml` one level up lets `gno test` resolve the realm package locally for the filetest):

```bash
cd tavern-board
gno test ./...
```

8 unit tests + 1 filetest (tip flows, leaderboard, refund). All pass (verified on Gno v1.8.0).

### Run Locally with gnodev

```bash
gnodev .
```

Open http://127.0.0.1:8888/r/tavernboard to see the rendered board. The default account (`g1jg8mtutu9khhfwc4nxmuhcpftf0pajdhfvsqf5`) is funded with ugnot; recover its key from the mnemonic gnodev prints, then call the realm:

```bash
# Create a post (gas-wanted must be >= ~5,000,000; a call uses ~3,000,000 gas)
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath gno.land/r/tavernboard -func CreatePost \
  -args "Hello" -args "First post" \
  -gas-fee 1000000ugnot -gas-wanted 5000000 -remote http://localhost:26657 <key>

# Tip post 1 with 1000 ugnot (attach the tip with -send)
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath gno.land/r/tavernboard -func TipPost \
  -args 1 -args 1000 -send 1000ugnot \
  -gas-fee 1000000ugnot -gas-wanted 5000000 -remote http://localhost:26657 <key>
```

Verified on gnodev: CreatePost (height 3), CreateReply (height 5), TipPost 1000ugnot (height 7); `GetPost(1)` shows TipTotal 1000, ReplyCount 1; front page and `:post/1` render correctly.

## Deployment

### Testnet (Onyx)

- **Chain ID**: `onyx-1`
- **Realm**: `gno.land/r/tavernboard`
- **Gnoweb**: https://onyx.testnets.gno.land/r/tavernboard
- **Explorer**: https://onyx.testnets.gno.land

### Deploy Steps

1. Create a testnet-only key:
   ```bash
   gnokey add tavern-board-testnet
   ```

2. Fund the key with test GNOT from the faucet:
   ```bash
   # Visit https://faucet.onyx.testnets.gno.land and request funds for your address
   # (web flow with captcha)
   ```

3. Deploy the realm:
   ```bash
   gnokey maketx addpkg \
     -pkgpath gno.land/r/tavernboard \
     -pkgdir . \
     -gas-fee 2000ugnot \
     -gas-wanted 10000000 \
     -chainid onyx-1 \
     -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443 \
     tavern-board-testnet
   ```
   Raise `-gas-wanted` if the simulation reports out of gas.

## Project Structure

```
gnome-tavern/
├── gnowork.toml      # workspace root (lets gno test resolve the realm locally)
└── tavern-board/
    ├── realm.gno          # Main realm implementation (Gno v1.8 API)
    ├── realm_test.gno     # Unit tests (posts, replies, render)
    ├── filetests/
    │   └── z_tip_filetest.gno  # Filetest (tip flows, leaderboard, refund)
    ├── gnomod.toml        # Module configuration (gno.land/r/tavernboard)
    ├── README.md          # This file
    ├── LICENSE            # MIT License
    └── BUILD-NOTES.md     # Build notes and verification log
```

## Realm Functions

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `CreatePost(title, body)` | Create a new post, returns post ID |
| `CreateReply(postID, body)` | Add a reply to a post, returns reply ID |
| `TipPost(postID, amount)` | Tip a post author with ugnot (attach with `-send <amount>ugnot`) |
| `TipReply(postID, replyID, amount)` | Tip a reply author with ugnot (attach with `-send`) |
| `GetPost(postID)` | Get a post by ID |
| `GetReplies(postID)` | Get all replies for a post |
| `GetPosts()` | Get all posts sorted by tips (leaderboard) |
| `GetAuthorTips(author)` | Get total tips received by an author |
| `Render(path)` | Gnoweb entry point — `""` = front page, `"post/<id>"` = post detail |

## License

MIT License - see [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details.

## Hackathon

Built for the Gnome Tavern Hackathon (DoraHacks + Gno.land).

package tavernboard

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"
	"gno.land/p/g1uhez53ghm94hh8m4ezxs82240ql87vfppjq0mc/tavernkit"
)

var (
	alice   = testutils.TestAddress("alice_sponsor")
	bob     = testutils.TestAddress("bob_builder")
	carol   = testutils.TestAddress("carol_cosponsor")
	rev1    = testutils.TestAddress("reviewer_one")
	rev2    = testutils.TestAddress("reviewer_two")
	rev3    = testutils.TestAddress("reviewer_three")
	janitor = testutils.TestAddress("janitor_cleanup")
)

func resetRealmState() {
	nextBountyID = 0
	bounties = avl.NewTree()
	profiles = avl.NewTree()
	statTotalBounties = 0
	statOpenBounties = 0
	statCompletedBounties = 0
	statDisputesResolved = 0
	statTotalFundedUgnot = 0
	statTotalPaidUgnot = 0
	statActiveEscrowUgnot = 0
	statArchivedBounties = 0
}

// attachSend sets the OriginSend envelope and credits this realm's bank balance
// (mirroring Tendermint2 MsgCall coin delivery before entering a crossing func).
// Call testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(user)) directly in the test frame
// alongside attachSend so the test frame's `cur` reflects the EOA caller.
func attachSend(ugnot int64) {
	if ugnot > 0 {
		coins := chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(nativeDenom, ugnot))
		testing.SetOriginSend(coins)
		testing.SetOriginSpend(nil)
		testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr, coins)
	} else {
		testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
		testing.SetOriginSpend(nil)
	}
}

func coinBalance(addr address) int64 {
	return banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(addr, nativeDenom)
}

func TestHappyPathMultiMilestoneAndVaultIsolation(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetRealmState()

	// 1. Alice posts Bounty #1 with 10 GNOT split 30/50/20 across 3 milestones.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(10_000_000)
	id1 := PostBounty(
		cross(cur),
		"Build On-Chain Indexer",
		"Deliver deterministic Gno event indexer with benchmarks.",
		"indexer,realm,go",
		"Spec & API:3000,Core Engine:5000,Benchmarks & Docs:2000",
		14,
		50_000,
		3,
	)
	urequire.Equal(t, uint64(1), id1)

	// 2. Alice also posts Bounty #2 with 4 GNOT to prove sub-realm vault isolation.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(4_000_000)
	id2 := PostBounty(
		cross(cur),
		"Write GnoConnect Guide",
		"Concise walkthrough for wallet signing.",
		"docs,wallet",
		"Full Delivery",
		7,
		0,
		0,
	)
	urequire.Equal(t, uint64(2), id2)

	v1 := DeriveEscrowAddress(id1)
	v2 := DeriveEscrowAddress(id2)
	uassert.NotEqual(t, v1, v2, "each bounty must have a unique sub-realm vault address")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(10_000_000), coinBalance(v1), "bounty 1 vault holds 10 GNOT")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(4_000_000), coinBalance(v2), "bounty 2 vault holds 4 GNOT")

	// 3. Carol co-funds Bounty #1 by 2 GNOT directly via TopUpBounty (+2 GNOT -> 12 GNOT total).
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	attachSend(2_000_000)
	newTotal := TopUpBounty(cross(cur), id1)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(12_000_000), newTotal)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(12_000_000), coinBalance(v1))

	// 4. External DAO/bank sends 1 GNOT straight to DeriveEscrowAddress(id1), then calls SyncBountyVault.
	testing.IssueCoins(v1, chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(nativeDenom, 1_000_000)))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	attachSend(0)
	synced := SyncBountyVault(cross(cur), id1)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_000_000), synced)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(13_000_000), coinBalance(v1))

	// Verify dust-free payout math across 30% / 50% / 20% of 13 GNOT = 3.9 + 6.5 + 2.6 = 13.0 GNOT.
	ms := GetMilestones(id1)
	urequire.Equal(t, 3, len(ms))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(13_000_000), ms[0].PayoutUgnot+ms[1].PayoutUgnot+ms[2].PayoutUgnot)

	// 5. Bob claims Bounty #1 (sponsor self-claim must abort).
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(0)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "sponsor cannot claim own bounty", func() {
		ClaimBounty(cross(cur), id1, "self claim attempt")
	})

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	attachSend(0)
	ClaimBounty(cross(cur), id1, "Shipping with full GnoVM test coverage.")

	// 6. Bob submits and Alice approves all 3 milestones sequentially.
	bobBefore := coinBalance(bob)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
		attachSend(0)
		SubmitMilestone(cross(cur), id1, i, "https://github.com/reactrailgun/tavernboard/pull/1", "Delivered milestone cleanly")

		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
		attachSend(0)
		ApproveMilestone(cross(cur), id1, i, "Verified and accepted!")
	}

	// Verify exact payouts, vault #1 drained to 0, vault #2 untouched at 4 GNOT!
	uassert.Equal(t, bobBefore+13_000_000, coinBalance(bob), "builder received exact 13 GNOT")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), coinBalance(v1), "bounty 1 escrow vault drained to 0")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(4_000_000), coinBalance(v2), "bounty 2 escrow vault completely untouched")

	snap, ok := GetBounty(id1)
	urequire.True(t, ok)
	uassert.Equal(t, tavernkit.StatusCompleted.String(), snap.Status.String())

	// 7. Verify Bob's on-chain composable reputation & Craft Tier.
	rep := GetReputation(bob)
	// 1 completed (250) + 3 milestones (240) + 13 GNOT * 5 (65) = 555 XP -> Journeyman!
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(555), rep.XP)
	uassert.Equal(t, tavernkit.TierJourneyman.String(), rep.Tier.String())
	uassert.True(t, HasCraftTier(bob, tavernkit.TierJourneyman))
	uassert.False(t, HasCraftTier(bob, tavernkit.TierArtisan))

	// 8. Permissionless storage-deposit reclamation via ArchiveClosedBounty!
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(janitor))
	attachSend(0)
	ArchiveClosedBounty(cross(cur), id1)
	snapAfter, _ := GetBounty(id1)
	uassert.True(t, snapAfter.Archived)
	uassert.Equal(t, tavernkit.StatusArchived.String(), snapAfter.Status.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, "", snapAfter.Summary, "heavy summary pruned to reclaim storage deposit")
}

func TestStakeBackedDisputeQuorumAndSlashing(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetRealmState()

	// Alice posts 6 GNOT single-milestone quest with 0.1 GNOT reviewer stake and quorum 3.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(6_000_000)
	id := PostBounty(
		cross(cur),
		"Audit Escrow Invariants",
		"Formal review of sub-realm banker boundaries.",
		"security,audit",
		"Audit Report",
		10,
		100_000,
		3,
	)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	attachSend(0)
	ClaimBounty(cross(cur), id, "Will inspect all cross-realm paths.")
	SubmitMilestone(cross(cur), id, 0, "https://github.com/reactrailgun/tavernboard/blob/main/AUDIT.md", "Full report submitted.")

	// Alice requests revision; Bob disagrees and escalates to stake-backed quorum.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(0)
	RequestRevision(cross(cur), id, 0, "Needs more coverage on sub-realms.")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	attachSend(0)
	OpenDispute(cross(cur), id, 0, "Sub-realm analysis is covered in section 4 of the report.")

	// Sponsor/builder cannot vote on own dispute.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(100_000)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "sponsor and builder cannot vote as reviewers on their own dispute", func() {
		StakeAndVoteDispute(cross(cur), id, 0, false, "trying to self-vote")
	})

	// Record reviewer starting balances.
	r1Before := coinBalance(rev1)
	r2Before := coinBalance(rev2)
	r3Before := coinBalance(rev3)
	bobBefore := coinBalance(bob)

	// Reviewer 1 stakes 100,000 ugnot and votes APPROVE builder.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev1))
	attachSend(100_000)
	resolved := StakeAndVoteDispute(cross(cur), id, 0, true, "Section 4 thoroughly covers sub-realm banker guards.")
	uassert.False(t, resolved)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(100_000), coinBalance(DeriveStakeAddress(id)))

	// Reviewer 2 stakes 100,000 ugnot and votes REJECT builder (minority dissenter).
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev2))
	attachSend(100_000)
	resolved = StakeAndVoteDispute(cross(cur), id, 0, false, "Not enough detail.")
	uassert.False(t, resolved)

	// Duplicate vote by Reviewer 1 must abort.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev1))
	attachSend(100_000)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "reviewer has already voted on this dispute", func() {
		StakeAndVoteDispute(cross(cur), id, 0, true, "double vote")
	})

	// Reviewer 3 stakes 100,000 ugnot and votes APPROVE builder -> 2-1 quorum reached & settles!
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev3))
	attachSend(100_000)
	resolved = StakeAndVoteDispute(cross(cur), id, 0, true, "Deliverable meets all criteria.")
	uassert.True(t, resolved)

	// Verify economic settlement:
	// - Bob wins 6,000,000 ugnot from escrow/<id>.
	// - Rev2 (dissenter) slashed 50% (50,000 ugnot) -> gets 50,000 back.
	// - Rev1 & Rev3 (aligned) split the 50,000 slash pool (+25,000 each) -> get 125,000 each.
	// - Both escrow/<id> and stake/<id> vaults drain cleanly to 0 ugnot!
	uassert.Equal(t, bobBefore+6_000_000, coinBalance(bob), "builder paid on quorum win")
	uassert.Equal(t, r1Before+125_000, coinBalance(rev1), "aligned reviewer 1 got principal + 25k slash bonus")
	uassert.Equal(t, r2Before+50_000, coinBalance(rev2), "dissenting reviewer 2 slashed 50%")
	uassert.Equal(t, r3Before+125_000, coinBalance(rev3), "aligned reviewer 3 got principal + 25k slash bonus")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), coinBalance(DeriveEscrowAddress(id)), "escrow vault empty")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), coinBalance(DeriveStakeAddress(id)), "stake vault empty")

	// Verify reviewer reputation alignment vs slashing.
	p1 := GetProfile(rev1)
	p2 := GetProfile(rev2)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), p1.ReviewsAligned)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), p1.ReviewsSlashed)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), p2.ReviewsSlashed)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), p2.Score.ReliabilityBps)
}

func TestSecurityPaymentGuardBlocksCodeRealmSpoofing(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetRealmState()

	// Regression test per Effective Gno § Verifying inbound Coin payments:
	// An intermediate code realm carrying OriginSend metadata MUST be rejected
	// by cur.Previous().IsUserCall() so it cannot mint fake escrow balances.
	attackerRealm := testing.NewCodeRealm("gno.land/r/attacker/wrapper")
	testing.SetRealm(attackerRealm)
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(nativeDenom, 5_000_000)))

	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "direct user call (maketx call) required for coin transfers", func() {
		PostBounty(cross(cur), "Spoofed", "Fake funding", "sec", "Full", 7, 0, 0)
	})
}

func TestSecurityProofURLRejectsXSSScheme(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetRealmState()

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(1_000_000)
	id := PostBounty(cross(cur), "Build Widget", "Needs clean proof", "ui", "Full", 7, 0, 0)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	attachSend(0)
	ClaimBounty(cross(cur), id, "On it")

	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "proofURL rejected", func() {
		SubmitMilestone(cross(cur), id, 0, "javascript:alert(1)", "bad link")
	})
}

func TestCancelOpenAndReclaimExpiredBounty(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetRealmState()

	aliceBefore := coinBalance(alice)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(2_000_000)
	id := PostBounty(cross(cur), "Temporary Task", "Cancel before claim", "ops", "Full", 1, 0, 0)

	// Cancel unclaimed bounty immediately -> full 2 GNOT refunded.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(0)
	refunded := CancelOrReclaimExpired(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2_000_000), refunded)
	uassert.Equal(t, aliceBefore+2_000_000, coinBalance(alice))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), coinBalance(DeriveEscrowAddress(id)))

	// Claimed bounty cannot be cancelled before deadline, but CAN be reclaimed after expiry.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(3_000_000)
	id2 := PostBounty(cross(cur), "Expiring Task", "Will expire", "ops", "Full", 1, 0, 0)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	attachSend(0)
	ClaimBounty(cross(cur), id2, "Claimed but abandoned")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(0)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "claimed bounty cannot be cancelled before deadline", func() {
		CancelOrReclaimExpired(cross(cur), id2)
	})

	// Advance chain time past 1 day (17300 blocks * 5s > 86400s).
	testing.SkipHeights(17300)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(0)
	refunded2 := CancelOrReclaimExpired(cross(cur), id2)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(3_000_000), refunded2)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), coinBalance(DeriveEscrowAddress(id2)))
}

func TestRenderSanitizationAndAllRoutes(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetRealmState()

	// Post a bounty containing hostile Markdown/table/HTML injection characters.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(5_000_000)
	id := PostBounty(
		cross(cur),
		"Fix | Table | [Evil](javascript:alert(1))",
		"# Fake Heading\n<script>alert(1)</script>\nDeliver clean fix.",
		"security,markdown",
		"Patch:10000",
		7,
		0,
		0,
	)

	// Home view renders cleanly: hostile markdown links & pipes are neutralized.
	home := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "TavernBoard"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "5 GNOT"))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(home, "](javascript:"), "javascript link must be neutralized")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, `\[Evil\]`), "brackets must be escaped")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "|"), "table pipes must be escaped")

	// Bounty detail view renders SVG escrow card, vault address, and txlink actions.
	detail := Render("bounty/1")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "data:image/svg+xml;base64,"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, DeriveEscrowAddress(id).String()))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "$help&func=ClaimBounty"))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(detail, "\n# Fake Heading"), "fake ATX heading must be escaped")
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(detail, "\n<script>"), "raw HTML block opener must be escaped")

	// Guild hall, builder crest, guide, and JSON query API all render cleanly.
	guild := Render("guild")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(guild, "Guild Hall"))

	builderView := Render("builder/" + alice.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(builderView, "data:image/svg+xml;base64,"))

	guide := Render("guide")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(guide, "Sub-Realm Escrow"))

	rawJSON := GetBoardJSON(10)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(rawJSON, `"totalBounties":1`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(rawJSON, DeriveEscrowAddress(id).String()))
}

func TestBuilderGracePeriodDisputeAndSponsorQuorumWin(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetRealmState()

	aliceBefore := coinBalance(alice)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	attachSend(4_000_000)
	id := PostBounty(cross(cur), "Build Benchmark", "Must pass gas target", "perf", "Full", 14, 100_000, 3)

	// Bob claims, then releases claim, then claims again.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	attachSend(0)
	ClaimBounty(cross(cur), id, "First attempt")
	ReleaseClaim(cross(cur), id)
	ClaimBounty(cross(cur), id, "Committed attempt")
	SubmitMilestone(cross(cur), id, 0, "https://github.com/reactrailgun/tavernboard/pull/9", "Submitted draft")

	// Builder cannot dispute immediately while sponsor is inside 48h grace period.
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "sponsor still within 48h review grace period", func() {
		OpenDispute(cross(cur), id, 0, "impatient")
	})

	// Advance chain past 48h (34600 blocks * 5s > 48h) -> builder can escalate!
	testing.SkipHeights(34600)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	attachSend(0)
	OpenDispute(cross(cur), id, 0, "Sponsor unresponsive past 48h")

	// Quorum votes 2-1 in favor of SPONSOR (rejects incomplete deliverable).
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev1))
	attachSend(100_000)
	StakeAndVoteDispute(cross(cur), id, 0, false, "Benchmarks do not pass")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev2))
	attachSend(100_000)
	StakeAndVoteDispute(cross(cur), id, 0, true, "Looks okay to me")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev3))
	attachSend(100_000)
	resolved := StakeAndVoteDispute(cross(cur), id, 0, false, "Missing gas metrics")
	uassert.True(t, resolved)

	// Escrow refunded to Alice; Bob incurs DisputesLost=1; vault drained to 0.
	uassert.Equal(t, aliceBefore+4_000_000, coinBalance(alice), "sponsor refunded on quorum win")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), coinBalance(DeriveEscrowAddress(id)))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), coinBalance(DeriveStakeAddress(id)))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), GetProfile(bob).DisputesLost)
}

package tavernboard

import (
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/g1uhez53ghm94hh8m4ezxs82240ql87vfppjq0mc/tavernkit"
)

// All core stateful data types are declared inside /r/tavernboard (never /p/)
// per the Gno Security Guide so foreign /p/ packages cannot reference or
// launder write authority against realm-owned structs.

type bounty struct {
	id                    uint64
	title                 string
	summary               string
	tags                  string
	sponsor               address
	builder               address
	builderPitch          string
	status                tavernkit.Status
	totalFundedUgnot      int64
	totalReleasedUgnot    int64
	totalRefundedUgnot    int64
	vaultAccountedUgnot   int64
	createdAt             time.Time
	deadline              time.Time
	minReviewerStakeUgnot int64
	reviewerQuorum        int
	milestones            []*milestone
	archived              bool
}

type milestone struct {
	index           int
	title           string
	weightBps       int64
	payoutUgnot     int64
	status          tavernkit.MilestoneStatus
	proofURL        string
	deliveryNotes   string
	sponsorFeedback string
	revisionCount   int
	submittedAt     time.Time
	settledAt       time.Time
	dispute         *dispute
}

type dispute struct {
	openedBy       address
	reason         string
	openedAt       time.Time
	votes          []*reviewVote
	approveCount   int
	rejectCount    int
	stakePoolUgnot int64
	resolved       bool
	builderWon     bool
	resolvedAt     time.Time
}

type reviewVote struct {
	reviewer       address
	approveBuilder bool
	stakeUgnot     int64
	rationale      string
	castAt         time.Time
}

type builderProfile struct {
	addr               address
	completedBounties  int64
	approvedMilestones int64
	totalEarnedUgnot   int64
	reviewsAligned     int64
	reviewsSlashed     int64
	disputesWon        int64
	disputesLost       int64
	bountiesPosted     int64
	bountiesClaimed    int64
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Exported immutable value snapshots (safe to return cross-realm; zero aliases)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// MilestoneSnapshot is an immutable read-only view of a bounty milestone.
type MilestoneSnapshot struct {
	Index           int
	Title           string
	WeightBps       int64
	PayoutUgnot     int64
	Status          tavernkit.MilestoneStatus
	ProofURL        string
	DeliveryNotes   string
	SponsorFeedback string
	RevisionCount   int
	HasDispute      bool
	ApproveVotes    int
	RejectVotes     int
	DisputeResolved bool
	BuilderWon      bool
}

// BountySnapshot is an immutable read-only view of a bounty and its vaults.
type BountySnapshot struct {
	ID                    uint64
	Title                 string
	Summary               string
	Tags                  string
	Sponsor               address
	Builder               address
	Status                tavernkit.Status
	TotalFundedUgnot      int64
	TotalReleasedUgnot    int64
	TotalRefundedUgnot    int64
	EscrowVaultAddr       address
	StakeVaultAddr        address
	EscrowVaultLiveUgnot  int64
	StakeVaultLiveUgnot   int64
	CreatedAtUnix         int64
	DeadlineUnix          int64
	MinReviewerStakeUgnot int64
	ReviewerQuorum        int
	MilestoneCount        int
	SettledMilestones     int
	Archived              bool
}

// ProfileSnapshot is an immutable read-only summary of a participant's reputation.
type ProfileSnapshot struct {
	Address            address
	Score              tavernkit.ReputationScore
	CompletedBounties  int64
	ApprovedMilestones int64
	TotalEarnedUgnot   int64
	ReviewsAligned     int64
	ReviewsSlashed     int64
	DisputesWon        int64
	DisputesLost       int64
	BountiesPosted     int64
	BountiesClaimed    int64
}

// BoardStats is an immutable aggregate snapshot of realm-wide activity.
type BoardStats struct {
	TotalBounties     int64
	OpenBounties      int64
	CompletedBounties int64
	DisputesResolved  int64
	TotalFundedUgnot  int64
	TotalPaidUgnot    int64
	ActiveEscrowUgnot int64
	RankedBuilders    int
	ArchivedBounties  int64
}
